findings.title: False friend: real-time
findings.summary: GTM means live-on-the-call freshness; PRD means a snappy UI; architecture rejects streaming ingest in v1.

evidence.must_contain: in real-time, while you are still on the call
Real-time means the UI feels instant
"Real-time" as streaming ingest is out of scope

findings.title: False friend: understands the plant
findings.summary: The CXO headline is fluency; Product scoped templates; Tech requires ID honesty and retrieval.

evidence.must_contain: AI that understands the plant
Three starter question templates
Inventing an `externalId` is worse than saying "I don't know."

findings.title: False friend: MVP
findings.summary: GTM wants a sales-cycle demo next month; Product means three templates; Tech means a narrow tool surface with SLOs.

evidence.must_contain: something we can show in a sales cycle next month
MVP means these three templates
No write tools registered

findings.title: False friend: source of truth
findings.summary: GTM says Cognite; Product says never leave Fusion; Tech means a named view, not RAW.

evidence.must_contain: Cognite is the source of truth
The user never has to leave Fusion
Source of truth is a specific view in a specific space — not RAW

findings.title: Unpriced promise: ask anything vs three templates
findings.summary: GTM and the board slide promise open-ended operations Q&A; Product scoped three templates; architecture can build a narrow read-only tool surface.

evidence.must_contain: Ask anything about your operations
ask anything about your operations
not an open-ended assistant

findings.title: Orphaned constraint: cluster-local answers
findings.summary: Architecture forbids leaving the customer cluster; the PRD and GTM one-pager never say so.

evidence.must_contain: Answers must not leave the customer's CDF cluster / region
Cluster-local stays non-negotiable

findings.title: Orphaned constraint: no invented externalIds
findings.summary: ID hallucination is an architecture Sev-1. The intern ticket and GTM copy do not mention it.

evidence.must_contain: Inventing an `externalId` is worse than saying "I don't know."
Add a text box on Search

findings.title: Orphaned constraint: p95 and citation coverage as launch blockers
findings.summary: PRD treats snappy UI as a feel; Slack and ADRs treat p95 and citation coverage as launch blockers.

evidence.must_contain: p95 target: snappy
p95 latency and citation coverage are launch blockers, not polish
Citation coverage is a launch blocker, not polish

findings.title: Artifact silo: write-from-chat
findings.summary: GTM implies CMMS write; PRD forbids writes; HLD registers no write tools. Each document is internally consistent.

evidence.must_contain: create a work order from the answer
Write actions (no CMMS, no work orders)
No write tools registered

findings.title: Downward loss: grounding dies into a text box
findings.summary: CXO said AI that understands the plant. The intern ticket is add a text box on Search.

evidence.must_contain: AI that understands the plant
Add a text box on Search
No link to the CXO sentence, grounding rules, or citations
